question: Does installing @dimforge/rapier3d-compat add an eagerly loaded chunk to apps that never use physics, and does this branch change that?
answer: Yes, and no. With Rapier installed, a no-physics app emits one Rapier chunk of 2853.75 kB (1082.64 kB gzip -9) and the browser fetches it at startup, with the published 5.0.2 engine and with this branch alike (also under the aura3d-no-tla condition). Without Rapier installed nothing Rapier-related is emitted.

setup.consumer: Clean Vite 8 project (node_modules = npm install of the @aura3d/engine@5.0.2 dependency tree + vite + typescript + @dimforge/rapier3d-compat@0.20.0); @aura3d/engine replaced by the tarball under test. 'absent' = node_modules/@dimforge moved away before the build.

apps.nophys: src/main.ts: createAuraApp with one lit box, no physics

branch.source: pnpm build && npm pack of this branch (lane/514-physics-out-of-box, engine source as of 59106f712)

setup.gzip: zlib level 9 over each emitted file
setup.fetch: headless Chrome via loopback CDP, Network.requestWillBeSent over 8 s after navigation (tools/ccap.mjs)
